props.headline: Cut first-response time from 38 minutes to 7
props.body: Hartwell Direct, a DTC home-goods brand with 400k customers, flipped Solva on inside Zendesk. Within six weeks the AI was confidently resolving 41% of inbound — order tracking, return labels, sizing — and drafting the rest. First-response dropped from 38 minutes to 7. CSAT lifted from 76 to 87. Headcount stayed flat.

props.headline: Saved $1.2M / year in support headcount avoidance
props.body: Vespertine Cloud, a B2B SaaS company growing 80% YoY, faced doubling their support team or doubling per-ticket cost. Solva deflected 35% of inbound from the first month and the team handled 2.1x ticket volume with the same eight agents. Twelve-month run-rate savings: $1.2M. Time-to-payback: 7 weeks.

props.title: Trained on your knowledge base
props.description: Connect your existing help center, Notion, or Confluence and Solva indexes it in under an hour. Every response cites source articles. No hallucinated policy. When the docs don't have an answer, Solva says so and routes the ticket to a human — never invents.

props.title: Drafts that sound like your team
props.description: Point Solva at 200 historical tickets and it learns your voice — the greeting, the sign-off, the way you handle frustrated customers. Drafts arrive in the agent's inbox sounding like a teammate wrote them. Average edit-and-send time: 12 seconds.

props.title: Analytics your CFO will read
props.description: Live dashboard showing deflection rate, time saved, cost per resolved ticket, and CSAT lift — broken down by channel, queue, and ticket type. Export to CSV for your monthly board deck. Public methodology so your finance team can verify the math.
